title: malus communis var. sylvestris
intro: Malus communis var. sylvestris, commonly known as the wild apple or European wild apple, is a deciduous shrub or small tree belonging to the Rosaceae family. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include supporting digestive health and providing antioxidant properties, helping to protect against oxidative stress and inflammation. Malus communis var. sylvestris contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The plant's therapeutic actions also include potential antidiabetic and anti-cancer properties, although further research is needed to confirm these effects.
